description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for managing firmware upgrades, including installing files, running hooks, querying system info, and performing firmware flashing to MTD partitions.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a target directory, creating symlinks for symbolic links and copying regular files.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs a binary file and its dependencies if executable.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer with a default.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: rootfs_type
methods.description: Determines the root filesystem type.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads an image file, optionally decompressing based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_image_dd
methods.description: Streams an image with optional dd processing.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads magic bytes to identify file type.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads longer magic bytes for file type identification.

methods.name: get_magic_gpt
methods.description: Reads GPT partition table magic bytes.

methods.name: get_magic_vfat
methods.description: Reads VFAT magic bytes.

methods.name: get_magic_fat32
methods.description: Reads FAT32 magic bytes.

methods.name: identify_magic_long
methods.description: Identifies file type based on magic bytes.

methods.name: part_magic_efi
methods.description: Checks for EFI partition magic.

methods.name: part_magic_fat
methods.description: Checks for FAT or FAT32 magic.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Determines and exports the boot device based on kernel command line.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device name based on major/minor device numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts little-endian 32-bit hex to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from a device and outputs partition info.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by writing image to MTD partition.
